source_assets.text: At the art table, Kai said, "Everyone may use my pencils." He slipped the blue pencil into his pocket. In private, he added, "I want to save this one for my drawing."

At the workshop door, Mira told the visitors, "A repair belongs to everyone who helped."
Tomas fitted the loose hinge while Mira found the screws. Together they checked that the door would close.
When the visitors returned, Mira moved the repair card so it covered Tomas's name. "I did this one," she told them.
"But you asked me to mend the hinge," Tomas said quietly.
Mira drew him aside and whispered, "Let me have the credit today; I need the prize."
The door stayed open while the visitors inspected the table.
source_assets.rights: Original authored fiction; no external factual authority claimed.

source_assets.text:
During the food-drive meeting, Leena said, "Our collection is a team effort."
Later, she showed the organizer a list headed "Collected by Leena". The list included the bags that Sam had brought.
Sam asked her to add his name. Leena picked up a pen and wrote it beneath her own.
"I had only put down one name because the form had one box," she said. "We both brought food."
The organizer replaced the form with a blank sheet, and Leena wrote both names at the top.
source_assets.rights: Original authored fiction; no external factual authority claimed.

prior_exposure.content:
First distinguish what a person says publicly, what they do, and what they report wanting. Then form a claim, choose a quotation, and explain the link. Treat a later passage as new evidence: the earlier answer may not fit it.

Model passage:
At the art table, Kai said, "Everyone may use my pencils." He slipped the blue pencil into his pocket. In private, he added, "I want to save this one for my drawing."

Worked example: Kai's offer is a public statement; putting the pencil in his pocket is a physical action; the private line reports a wish. A bounded conclusion is that he offers pencils generally but keeps one back. "He slipped the blue pencil into his pocket" supports that exception because it removes that pencil from the shared supply. This does not prove that Kai never shares or reveal what he will do later.

Garden club notebook, Friday
Tray A stood beside the classroom window. Its eight seedlings were 18 days old. Their mean height was 9 cm.
Tray B stood on a shaded shelf. Its eight seedlings were 12 days old. Their mean height was 6 cm.
The club had placed the older seedlings in Tray A and the younger seedlings in Tray B. It had not assigned seedlings of the same age to the two locations.
Nia wrote, "The window light made the seedlings 3 cm taller."
source_assets.rights: Original authored fiction; no external factual authority claimed.

source_assets.text:
Reading club notebook, Thursday
Group A read the same 400-word passage in a room with quiet music. Its mean reading time was 4 minutes. The group consisted of students who had already practised that passage.
Group B read it in a silent room. Its mean reading time was 6 minutes. Those students had not seen the passage before.
Students were placed in the groups by whether they had practised, rather than by a random draw.
A poster said, "Quiet music cuts reading time by 2 minutes."
source_assets.rights: Original authored fiction; no external factual authority claimed.

prior_exposure.content:
An observation records what happened or how a comparison was set up. A causal claim says why it happened. When groups differ in several ways, their recorded difference alone does not isolate one cause. State what is observed, identify a relevant changed factor, and explain what remains uncertain.

Model passage:
Team P assembled a simple model with large pieces in a mean time of 8 minutes. Team Q assembled a complex model with small pieces in a mean time of 12 minutes. A note claimed, "Large pieces made the work 4 minutes faster."

Worked example: The recorded times and piece sizes are observations or setup details; the note gives a causal explanation. Both piece size and model complexity differ. The quotation "a complex model with small pieces" identifies an alternative difference, so this comparison does not isolate a piece-size effect. It also does not establish that complexity caused the whole difference.
prior_exposure.timing: Before the sequence; the transfer passage is withheld until the final task.
